_about: Timed tiles (TimedClearParser): {"activity|alias…", signature…}. Lower-cased activity, as configured on the tile, -> substrings that, if present in a nearby chat line, identify that activity (the boss/raid kill or completion-count line usually names the boss, not the activity). An activity not listed is its own signature.

_notes.inferno: Zuk's kill-count line only — never the bare word: TzHaar-Ket-Rak's challenges end with "You need to complete the Inferno to unlock …", which credited a 3:11 Jad challenge to a 65-minute Inferno tile.
_notes.chambers of xeric|cox: Raid-mode shorthands, so a mode tile matches however the admin phrased it. Colons and spacing are already folded away by norm(), so we only enumerate the abbreviations here; each pins the EXACT game count-line substring. A CM/HM/Expert tile must carry the full mode text so a *base*-mode clear (whose line omits it) can't wrongly complete it — while a base-raid tile keeps matching every harder mode (the mode line contains the base name).
_notes.the fractured archive|fractured archive|: Raids 4: "Your completed Fractured Archive count is: N" carries no article.
_notes.the gauntlet: The completion line reads "Your Gauntlet completion count is: N" — it never contains "the gauntlet", so a self-signature could never match. "your gauntlet completion" is also Corrupted-safe: CG's line reads "your corrupted gauntlet completion count".
_notes.the leviathan: Bosses whose kill-count line drops the article ("Your Leviathan kill count is: N"), so a tile named with "The …" would miss on the plain-substring fallback.
_notes.nex: "nex" is too short for the contains-fallback — "next" in any nearby line would false-match. Pin it to the real kill-count line.
_notes.barracuda trials|barracuda trial: Sailing Barracuda Trials: no chat line ever says "barracuda", so a generic any-trial tile needs the three course names. Tiles naming a specific course ("Gwenith Glide") ride the plain fallback — both flanking lines name it.
_notes.hallowed sepulchre|sepulchre: Hallowed Sepulchre full runs: no chat line says "sepulchre" either — the exit message is "Overall time: 26:39.20", which both carries the time and identifies the run. Floor tiles ("Floor 5") ride the fallback against "Floor 5 time: ...".
